A masked woman is seated very close—roughly one arm’s length away—facing partly toward the camera wearer, with no one blocking the wearer’s path. Several upholstered waiting chairs line the wall, and the camera turns toward an empty chair and nearby side table within reach. There is no visible equipment, towel station, or skincare shipment to handle. The socially appropriate action is therefore to wait patiently for the appointment to be called, respecting the established appointment system.
